test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched (instrument to the artist)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakhawaj - Shiv Kumar Sharma**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shiv Kumar Sharma** is renowned for his expertise in playing the **Santoor**, not the Pakhawaj.
 
• **Amjad Ali Khan** is a celebrated Sarod player.
 
• **Kishan Maharaj** is well-known for his skill with the Tabla.
 
• **Pt. Ravi Shankar** is globally acclaimed for his mastery of the Sitar.
 
• The **Pakhawaj** is a traditional Indian percussion instrument, distinct from the instruments associated with the other listed artists.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pakhawaj** is primarily used in the Dhrupad style of Indian classical music and is similar to the Mridangam.
 
• **Shiv Kumar Sharma** has been instrumental in popularizing the Santoor, an instrument from the Kashmir Valley, on the global stage.
 
• Each artist mentioned has significantly contributed to their respective instruments and Indian classical music as a whole.
